name: a_press_releases
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Friday October 16, 2026. Topic: Press releases: deals & contracts.

Window: Thursday October 15, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Friday October 16, 2026 02:03 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. Anything published after 02:03 ET on Friday October 16, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Press releases (BusinessWire, PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire, company IR) from US-listed companies >= $1B and large foreign ADRs: acquisitions and take-privates (price per share, CVRs), contract awards >= $100M, final investment decisions, JV awards, licensing and exchange/index agreements, dealer or asset purchases. One bullet per company with the $ figure and stock move.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## **CCC** `[Software & SaaS]`
- CCC Intelligent Solutions (**CCC**) agreed to be acquired by GTCR and Elliott Investment Management in an all-cash transaction with approximately **$6.1 billion enterprise value**; shareholders will receive **$7.75 per share**. Closing is expected in Q1 2027, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals. Stock move was not reported in the available source. (GlobeNewswire, Oct. 15, 2026; publication time not stated)[7]

## **PAG** `[Retail]`
- Penske Automotive Group (**PAG**) agreed to be taken private by Penske Corporation and Mitsui & Co. for **$212.00 per share in cash**, valuing the company at approximately **$16.3 billion enterprise value**; ownership after closing is expected to be approximately **64% Penske and 36% Mitsui**. Stock move was not reported in the available source. (PR Newswire, Oct. 15, 2026; publication time not stated)[9][10]

## **HON Hai / Foxconn** `[Semiconductors]`
- Foxconn Assembly Holding agreed to acquire **53.7 million shares of Q-Edge Corporation at $10 per share**, for a total transaction value of **$537 million**; stock move was not reported in the available source. (Hon Hai regulatory filing, Oct. 15, 2026; publication time not stated)[2]

## **ATCH** `[Financial Services]`
- AtlasClear Holdings (**ATCH**) signed an agreement to acquire Ark Financial Services, parent of Dawson James Securities, and simultaneously purchased **24.9%** of Ark; the remaining **75.1%** is subject to FINRA approval and other closing conditions. Consideration for the remaining acquisition is a fixed **$13.8125 million** in AtlasClear stock, priced at the five-day VWAP at closing. Stock move was not reported in the available source. (GlobeNewswire, Oct. 15, 2026; 07:00 ET)[5]

## **AIMV** `[AI / Healthcare Software]`
- AI Maverick Intel (**AIMV**) agreed to acquire Heal Access Canada for **$5 million**, subject to adjustment, plus **20 million exchangeable shares**; closing requires at least **$6 million** of financing, with the company targeting completion by Dec. 31, 2026. Stock move was not reported in the available source. (ACCESS Newswire, Oct. 15, 2026; 13:00 ET)[8]

## **ECGI** `[Pharma / Healthcare]`
- ECGI Holdings (**ECGI**) completed its acquisition of Avanta Group through the issuance of **17.16 million Series A voting convertible preferred shares**; **10.296 million shares** vested at closing, while the remaining **6.864 million** are subject to performance-based vesting tied to **$100 million** and **$200 million** annual-revenue thresholds. ECGI is an OTC-listed company and does not meet the requested $1 billion market-cap threshold; stock move was not reported. (GlobeNewswire, Oct. 15, 2026; publication time not stated)[1]

## **Macro / Calendar**
- TCGX Acquisition Corp. II priced an IPO of **10 million Class A shares at $10 per share**, for **$100 million** in gross proceeds; the SPAC was formed to pursue a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, or similar business combination. Stock move was not reported. (Business Wire, Oct. 15, 2026; 17:13 ET)[3]
